title: Refractive Index Calculation
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the refractive index as √3 (≈1.732) using Snell's law with i=60° and r=30° at point A.

title: Critical Angle Determination
description: Important: Correctly determines the critical angle C using sin C = 1/n, where n is the refractive index from part (1).

title: Exit Radius Geometry
description: Important: Correctly identifies the relevant geometry for the exit radius, relating the horizontal distance from the axis to the critical angle via tangent.

title: Final Radius Expression
description: Essential: Provides the final radius in the requested form: R = (√2 + √6)/2 cm or its decimal equivalent.

title: Angle Identification Error
description: Pitfall: Confuses the angles of incidence and refraction at point A (e.g., using 30° for i and 60° for r).

title: Geometry Setup
description: Important: Correctly uses the given lengths (OA=2cm, AB=1cm, BC=√3 cm) to establish the geometric relationships for both parts.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units (cm) throughout the calculation and presents the final answer with correct units.
